class.name: RigKernel
class.brief_description: The per-step state reading and drive-target writing of a learned controller for a physics rig.
class.description: Does, in native code, the work a learned controller repeats every control step on a ragdoll of rigid bodies joined by 6DOF joints with angular drives: reads every body's transform and velocities from the [PhysicsServer3D] once ([method update]), builds the policy's observation ([method observation]) and a motion prior's features ([method features]) from that state, casts rays for the ground under the body ([method ground]), reports foot contacts ([method contact]), and writes an action to the joints' drive targets ([method write_targets]). Configure it once with [method set_bodies], [method set_pelvis_head], one [method add_drive] per actuated joint in action order (which also defines the observed joints), [method set_contacts], [method set_keypoints], [method set_scan] and [method set_ground_mask]. Rotations are expressed as rotation vectors (axis times angle) of a child body relative to its parent, and the heading frame is the pelvis's yaw about world up with +Z forward.

method.name: add_drive
method.description: Adds an actuated joint: the 6DOF [param joint] whose child is [param body]. Each of its [param axes] (0, 1, 2 for x, y, z) takes one action value [code]a[/code], and the drive target's rotation vector is [code]nominal + scale * clamp(a, -1, 1)[/code] on those axes, clamped per component to [param lo] and [param hi]. The observation and features report the joint's rotation on the same axes.

method.name: contact
method.description: Returns whether any of the left ([param side] 0) or right (1) contact bodies touches something that is not one of the rig's bodies. The bodies need contact reporting enabled.

method.name: features
method.description: Returns motion-prior features of the state read by [method update]: the pelvis's height over [param ground_y]; its y and z axes in the heading frame; its linear and angular velocity in the heading frame by finite difference from [param pelvis_prev] at [param fps]; the driven joints' rotations on their axes; and the keypoints relative to the pelvis in the heading frame.

method.name: get_action_size
method.description: Returns the number of action values, the total of the drives' axes.

method.name: get_angular_velocity
method.description: Returns the angular velocity of body [param body] read by [method update].

method.name: get_center_of_mass
method.description: Returns the rig's center of mass read by [method update].

method.name: get_center_of_mass_velocity
method.description: Returns the velocity of the rig's center of mass read by [method update].

method.name: get_ground_data
method.description: Returns the ground data set by [method set_ground_data].

method.name: get_heading
method.description: Returns the heading frame read by [method update]: the pelvis's yaw about world up, +Z forward.

method.name: get_linear_velocity
method.description: Returns the linear velocity of body [param body] read by [method update].

method.name: get_scan_size
method.description: Returns the number of the height scan's points.

method.name: get_transform
method.description: Returns the transform of body [param body] read by [method update].

method.name: get_water_data
method.description: Returns the water inputs' data.

method.name: get_water_size
method.description: Returns the number of water inputs (the points' and 3), or 0.

method.name: ground
method.description: Returns the height of the first surface on the ground mask below [param point] (a ray from 1 m above it to 4 m below), or 1 m below the point if there is none.

method.name: heading_of
method.description: Returns the yaw of [param basis] about world up as a basis whose +Z is the basis's +Z projected on the horizontal plane.

method.name: observation
method.description: Returns the policy's observation of the state read by [method update]: gravity and the pelvis's angular velocity in the pelvis frame; the center of mass's velocity in the heading frame and its height over the ground; the driven joints' rotations, then their angular velocities relative to their parents (times 0.1); [param action]; [param command]; the left and right contacts; and, if [param scan], the ground's height at the scan points in the heading frame relative to the ground under the center of mass.

method.name: rotation_vector
method.description: Returns the rotation of [param basis] as a rotation vector (axis times angle, the angle in [code][0, PI][/code]).

method.name: set_bodies
method.description: Sets the rig's rigid bodies, their masses, and each one's parent index ([code]-1[/code] for the root). Body indices in the other methods refer to this order.

method.name: set_contacts
method.description: Sets the bodies whose contacts make the left and right contact of [method contact].

method.name: set_ground_data
method.description: Reads the ground from [param data] in place of every ray while it is set and enabled.

method.name: set_ground_mask
method.description: Sets the collision mask of [method ground]'s rays.

method.name: set_keypoints
method.description: Sets the points [method features] reports relative to the pelvis: each an offset in a body's frame.

method.name: set_pelvis_head
method.description: Sets which bodies are the pelvis (the heading frame's and the observation's reference) and the head.

method.name: set_scan
method.description: Sets the height scan's grid in the heading frame: lateral offsets [param x] and forward offsets [param z]; the observation lists it row by row of [param z].

method.name: set_scan_height
method.description: Sets how far above the pelvis the height scan's rays start (default 1.0). A ray starting inside a body does not hit it, so a wall taller than this reads as the ground at its foot; set it above the tallest wall the scan should see.

method.name: set_scan_points
method.description: Sets the height scan's points (x across, y ahead in the heading frame) in place of [method set_scan]'s grid.

method.name: set_static_ground
method.description: When enabled (default off), the ground probes consider static bodies only and the height scan's rays go to the physics server in one batch (Godot-EX's [code]JoltPhysicsServer3D.space_cast_static_ground[/code]; with another physics server, the general ray). Faster where the ground is all static, as on a training server; in a game a dynamic body can be ground.

method.name: set_water
method.description: Appends the water inputs to a scanned observation: the water's depth over the scan's ground at the scan points [param points] (0 where dry), its depth at the center of mass and its flow there in the heading frame (x, z), from [param data]'s water field (zeros without one).

method.name: update
method.description: Reads every body's transform and velocities from the physics server, and computes the center of mass and heading frame. Call it once per control step, after the physics steps, before the queries.

method.name: write_targets
method.description: Writes [param action] to the drives' target rotations (see [method add_drive]).
